37.name: Azay
37.peak: Weekend mornings (20-seat room) and late morning/lunch
37.offpeak_tip: Arrive by ~10am on weekends or come on a weekday; book ahead
37.basis: A Wanderlog reviewer arriving ~11:30am waited about 15 minutes; a weekday 11:30am visitor had no wait, and a Saturday 10am visitor got seats easily but saw the line grow. Guides call the 20-seat room packed on weekend mornings and advise reserving.

38.name: Cafe Dulce
38.offpeak_tip: Come before noon (opens ~7-8am); line moves fast and seating is tiny (~15), so plan to take it to go
38.basis: Reviews consistently say to expect a line, especially at lunch, but that staff move it efficiently; the only minute figure is a 2012 blog where a green tea doughnut order took about 20 minutes on a busy morning. Wanderlog notes 'expect long lines'.

40.name: Rakkan Ramen
40.peak: Weekend evenings; small room gets slammed at busy times
40.offpeak_tip: Lunch or weekday dinner; reviewers say it's quick at lunch and it's open late (to 1am Thu-Sat)
40.basis: HappyCow and Tripadvisor reviewers mention 'a bit of a wait on a Saturday evening' and that you may wait a while on busy days, but none give minutes; one chose it because it had no hour-long line like neighboring ramen shops.

41.name: Far Bar
41.peak: Weekend nights and big game nights (Dodgers/Lakers)
41.offpeak_tip: Weekday happy hour or weekend daytime (opens 10am Sat-Sun)
41.basis: No minute figures found. Reviews say it's crowded with slow food at peak times and you may wait for a patio table on a Saturday 9pm or game night; it's also used as a place to wait for nearby ramen shops.

42.name: Fugetsu-Do
42.offpeak_tip: Go early on a weekday; popular flavors can sell out
42.basis: Guides say that on weekends the line extends onto the sidewalk; Yelp reviewers split between 'really long at peak times' and 'wait minimal even with the snaking line'. No minute figure found.

44.name: Hana Ichimonme
44.offpeak_tip: Weekday lunch; tucked away on the Galleria's 3rd floor, away from the plaza crowds
44.reservations: Yelp reviewer suggests reserving if possible
44.basis: Yelp reviewers report being seated after about 10 minutes and a 10-15 minute wait; a Restaurantji review says 'very little wait'. Tripadvisor labels it closed while Yelp/Restaurantji show current hours, so verify.

45.name: Korea BBQ House
45.offpeak_tip: Weekday or Sunday afternoon; one reviewer found it quiet on a Sunday afternoon
45.reservations: Listed as accepting reservations; call ahead
45.basis: No source gave a wait time. Wanderlog Google-review snippets say it 'wasn't packed' before a concert and was quiet on a Sunday afternoon; one reviewer only guessed it gets busy on weekend nights.

46.name: Kouraku
46.peak: Weekend evenings and late night (Time Out: packed around 2am most Saturdays)
46.offpeak_tip: Weekday nights; a reviewer found it 'kind of empty' on a Tuesday
46.basis: Aggregator Atly says a bowl can mean a wait of over 30 minutes (undated, weak source); Wanderlog reviewers say it's 'usually full' and 'you might have to wait for seating sometimes', while Time Out notes it's packed at 2am on Saturdays.

49.name: Sushi Takeda
49.peak: Dinner seatings (signature omakase only at 6pm); closed Sunday per Michelin
49.offpeak_tip: Lunch service is the easiest walk-in option
49.reservations: Book on Tock (deposit per person); walk-ins possible
49.basis: Time Out says it 'does typically require advance booking' but is 'surprisingly easy to walk into', especially at lunch; it's a seated omakase, so no line-style wait was reported.

50.name: Mitsuru Cafe
50.offpeak_tip: Line moves fast; cash only; closed Mon, Tue, Thu per Franki listing
50.basis: The Infatuation mentions 'that line outside' for the red bean cakes and Atly says it draws long lines and gets very crowded during events, but reviewers say the line 'went pretty fast' (about 5 people ahead); no source gives minutes.

52.name: Mr. Ramen
52.offpeak_tip: Usually walk right in; a good alternative when Daikokuya's line is long
52.basis: A 2013 Umami Mart post says its sidewalk is 'conspicuously bare' while Daikokuya next door had about 15 people waiting; a recent MapQuest review snippet reportedly said no wait (not confirmed on the page). Usually-no-wait default of 0-10 used.

53.name: Oomasa
53.offpeak_tip: Arrive early, before the dinner rush
53.basis: Reviews say the wait can get pretty long at dinner and advise arriving early, especially during events; no minute estimates.

54.name: Orochon Ramen
54.offpeak_tip: Often less crowded than nearby Daikokuya
54.reservations: Walk-in; Pearl rates booking as easy
54.basis: No minutes found. A Nikkei View blogger went there because it wasn't crowded after a festival, and Pearl rates it easy to get into; one MapQuest listing says permanently closed, so status needs checking.

58.name: Sushi & Teri
58.basis: No source gave a wait time. A Talon Marks piece describes it as a quieter spot away from the busy Japanese Village Plaza scene.

60.name: Sushi Gen
60.peak: Lunch, especially right at opening and just after noon
60.offpeak_tip: Line up ~30 min before opening, or come around 1:30 pm when the lunch line thins
60.reservations: No reservations; leave your name and party size after the first seating
60.basis: Wanderlog says lines form before opening; a Tripadvisor reviewer was quoted 10-20 minutes at lunch rush, an Airbnb tip says 30+ minutes, and one reviewer who queued at 10:40 was seated around noon. The 60-minute max is a rounded upper end of these reports.

62.name: TaNoTa Takoyaki
62.offpeak_tip: Made to order at a walk-up window; ask for light sauce so they don't go soggy
62.basis: Google reviews summarized on Wanderlog praise fast service; one reviewer reported a 20-minute wait for their order. No source described regular lines.

63.name: Tea Master
63.offpeak_tip: Go on a weekday or off-peak; check hours, sources disagree
63.basis: Wanderlog reviewers said the wait was not long, about 10 minutes for an order; one guide (Atly) mentions very long weekend lines but gives no minutes, so weekend waits may exceed 10.

64.name: T.O.T. (Teishokuya of Tokyo)
64.basis: Only one report found: a diner said a 7 pm dinner had no long wait; it is not on Time Out's list of Little Tokyo spots known for waits.

66.name: Zencu Sushi & Grill
66.basis: A March 2025 TripAdvisor reviewer arriving about 4:40 pm waited 20-25 minutes, an October 2025 review reported no line for six at 4 pm, and Restaurantji calls it less crowded than other Little Tokyo sushi spots.

daikokuya.name: Daikokuya
daikokuya.offpeak_tip: Arrive at opening, or put your name down and walk around Little Tokyo while you wait
daikokuya.reservations: Walk-in only; put your name on the list at the door
daikokuya.basis: Review roundups describe waits from about 10 minutes to over an hour, an LA Mag writer recalled nearly an hour on the sidewalk, and The Infatuation says lines can get long; guides disagree on the single worst time.

monzo.name: Marugame Monzo
monzo.offpeak_tip: Arrive at opening; weekday lunch is easier
monzo.reservations: Walk-in; add your name to the waitlist at the door
monzo.basis: The Infatuation says the line can stretch outside on any day; individual diners reported about 40 minutes for a party of five on a Friday night and about 30 minutes on a stormy day, and Michelin advises coming early to put your name down on weekends.

alohacafe.name: Aloha Cafe
alohacafe.peak: Weekday lunch (open only Thu-Fri ~10:30am-3pm per recent listings)
alohacafe.offpeak_tip: Wanderlog suggests weekday lunch for quicker seating; check hours first, they are very limited
alohacafe.reservations: Back dining area can reportedly be reserved (Restaurantji); otherwise walk-in
alohacafe.basis: No source gives a wait in minutes. One older review calls it 'worth the wait' but mainly complains about the limited hours; Wanderlog and Restaurantji list Thu-Fri 10:30am-3pm only.

donatsu.name: Donatsu
donatsu.offpeak_tip: Appears permanently closed; verify before including on the map
donatsu.basis: Yelp (updated Nov 2026), Wanderlog and Postcard all list Donatsu at 330 E 2nd St as closed/permanently closed. No wait-time data found.

jist.name: JiST Cafe
jist.offpeak_tip: Arrive at opening or join the Yelp waitlist before arriving. NOTE: Yelp now lists it as CLOSED; verify before mapping
jist.basis: Yelp review snippets report ~5 min at 11am and under 3 min at opening, but 20-30 min just after noon and 30-45 min on a Saturday ~11am, with one party waiting 30 min past a 25-min quote. Yelp's listing header (Aug 2025 and Nov 2026) says CLOSED.

lasgalas.name: Las Galas
lasgalas.basis: No wait, crowd or reservation information found; listings (also called Sushi Gala) conflict on whether it is open, so status should be checked.

ltice.name: Little Tokyo Ice Cream & Yogurt
ltice.basis: Only an Atly listing found (mochi and green tea ice cream); it says nothing about lines or waits.

oomasa.name: Oomasa Restaurant
oomasa.offpeak_tip: Go on a weekday or just after the lunch peak
oomasa.reservations: First come, first served waitlist (sign in)
oomasa.basis: A Wanderlog reviewer on 'a very busy day for lunch' was about 10th on the list and waited under 30 minutes; others reported 'not much of a wait at dinner time' or being seated right away. Another reviewer says dinner waits after 6pm 'can get pretty long'.

ricenori.name: Rice & Nori
ricenori.peak: Weekends, when Little Tokyo is busiest (seating fills up)
ricenori.offpeak_tip: Mostly takeout counter; eat hand rolls right away so they don't get soggy
ricenori.basis: No source gave a wait time for the Little Tokyo shop. The Infatuation calls it a tiny onigiri shop in Weller Court; a review snippet notes limited seating that gets crowded on weekends, and another calls it very fast.

pastaepasta.name: Pasta e Pasta by Allegro
pastaepasta.offpeak_tip: The line usually moves faster than it looks
pastaepasta.basis: The Infatuation says expect a line for a table even on weeknights but it moves fast; one diner reported about 10 minutes to get in, another had no wait on a Saturday night.

sushikomasa.name: Sushi Komasa
sushikomasa.offpeak_tip: Listed as permanently closed: confirm before including on the map
sushikomasa.basis: Foursquare and Airbnb list it as closed (no closure date found). Older blogs (2010-2011) reported waits of about 45 minutes to an hour, and one undated review said under 15 minutes on weeknights.

tamon.name: Tamon
tamon.offpeak_tip: Lunch is the easier stop per one listing
tamon.reservations: Listed on OpenTable (as Tamon Sushi / Ohjah Lounge)
tamon.basis: No source gave a wait time. One reviewer recommended it over Gen, Komasa and Hama, which they called not worth the long wait, implying Tamon's is shorter.

tot.name: Teishokuya of Tokyo (T.O.T.)
tot.offpeak_tip: Good lunch spot; open Wed-Sun per one listing
tot.basis: No reliable wait data found. One Tripadvisor review mentions a 10-15 minute wait on a CicLAvia Sunday, but it sits on a different restaurant's page, so it was not used.

d1.name: Daikokuya
d1.offpeak_tip: Arrive at opening, or put your name down and walk around Little Tokyo while you wait
d1.reservations: Walk-in only; put your name on the list at the door
d1.basis: Review roundups describe waits from about 10 minutes to over an hour, an LA Mag writer recalled nearly an hour on the sidewalk, and The Infatuation says lines can get long; guides disagree on the single worst time.

d2.name: Marugame Monzo
d2.offpeak_tip: Arrive at opening; weekday lunch is easier
d2.reservations: Walk-in; add your name to the waitlist at the door
d2.basis: The Infatuation says the line can stretch outside on any day; individual diners reported about 40 minutes for a party of five on a Friday night and about 30 minutes on a stormy day, and Michelin advises coming early to put your name down on weekends.
